annotations.label: @ubnf
annotations.doc: 文法形式 v2 を指定します。製品のバージョンとは別です。

annotations.label: @feature
annotations.doc: この文法に必要な機能契約を記録します。

annotations.label: @package
annotations.doc: 生成 Java コードのパッケージです。

annotations.label: @root
annotations.doc: Marks the grammar entry point. Exactly one rule must be annotated.

annotations.label: @mapping
annotations.doc: Generates a Java record for this rule. `params` must match captures (`@name`) in positional order.

annotations.label: @leftAssoc
annotations.doc: Left-associative folding for `left { op right }` binary rules.

annotations.label: @rightAssoc
annotations.doc: Right-associative folding for binary rules.

annotations.label: @precedence
annotations.doc: Operator precedence level for this rule.

annotations.label: @whitespace
annotations.doc: ルールの連接境界で組込みまたは non-nullable な宣言的 token を読み飛ばします。

annotations.label: @enum
annotations.doc: Generates a Java enum from string-literal alternatives.

annotations.label: @commonField
annotations.doc: Lifts a field shared by all @mapping variants into the sealed interface.

annotations.label: @scopeTree
annotations.doc: Marks this rule as a scope boundary (enter/leave scope events).

annotations.label: @declares
annotations.doc: Registers the captured identifier as a symbol declaration in the current scope.

annotations.label: @backref
annotations.doc: Marks the capture as a reference to a previously declared symbol.

annotations.label: @import
annotations.doc: 宣言的 token の部品を相対パスから読み込みます。設定より前に置き、alias.TOKEN で参照します。任意のルール import は未対応です。

annotations.label: @recovery
annotations.doc: Recovery metadata. Execution support depends on the backend; do not assume recognition implies recovery support.

annotations.label: @skip
annotations.doc: Excludes this rule from AST output.

annotations.label: @interleave
annotations.doc: Interleave profile (whitespace/comment handling) for this rule.

annotations.label: @typeof
annotations.doc: Type query element for typed if/ternary support.

annotations.label: @catalog
annotations.doc: Associates the rule with an external symbol catalog context.

annotations.label: @eval
annotations.doc: Marks the rule for evaluator generation.

annotations.label: @doc
annotations.doc: Attaches documentation text to the rule.

annotations.label: @predicate
annotations.doc: Accepts the rule's match only if the pure condition registered under this name returns true.
